correctness.rationale: The Alexander dual of the total cut complex consists exactly of subsets meeting at most k-1 clique components, since its induced independence number equals the number of occupied components. Summing barycentric mass within each clique produces a full Γ-equivariant retraction to the (k-2)-skeleton of the simplex on c components; the uniform clique barycenter section is Γ-equivariant, and straight-line interpolation stays inside the allowed component support. Integral augmented simplex chains with summation contraction give wedge^{k-1}U_c, free and concentrated in degree k-2. Equivariant integral Alexander duality requires the sign of permutation on all N vertices and integral dualization. The factor det(1+tπ)/(1+t) gives the precise character, and an internal transposition acts as -1 on the lattice (each clique has >=2 vertices), killing rational invariants of the quotient. Independently enumerated total k-cut simplices and mod-two boundaries for three K2 components with k3, giving one H2 class, as formula predicts.
residual_risks: The integer dual and ambient vertex-sign twist are essential; treating their rational characters as integral isomorphisms would be invalid.
